upper_bound.witness: NON-SEQUITUR: Direct expansion gives (t-y)^2+4(t+c)(c-b), not the displayed expression with (b-c). Moreover, from the displayed inequality 0≤(t-y)^2+4(t+c)(b-c), one obtains b-c≥-(t-y)^2/[4(t+c)], not the claimed upper bound (5).
upper_bound.load_bearing: Estimate (5) supplies one direction of the quadratic displacement control (7). The partition argument proving that d is constant relies on that two-sided control, so the rigidity classification is not validly established as written.
